title: Classic reverb follows automated size, snaps its comb writes, and reports when its comb bank is silent

installed_sdk.rationale: ClassicReverb now re-derives its comb and allpass lengths as an automated size control moves, snaps each comb write so a silent tail reaches exact zero without flush-to-zero, and adds the read-only combs_silent() inspector. This pending source receipt does not establish a released SDK artifact.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: An in-process processor change adds no offline timeline command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: It adds no timeline MCP operation.

live_product_control.rationale: No remote control operation is added; size stays a baked node parameter driven like the reverb's other controls.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: classic_reverb.hpp is registered as reviewed infrastructure with no capability keys, so no installed agent capability is added or changed.
